label: Outcast register study (ferro pole)
description: Generate outcast-register candidates — field-repaired androids degraded by the planet. Asymmetric by repair history, accidental seams, warm sodium light, ZERO body neon.

style_prefix: anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain
low-key lighting with a strong shadow side and a single warm key
prompt_strategy._style_prefix_law: BOOTSTRAP PHASE ONLY. There is no trained LoRA yet, so the prompt is the ONLY source of style — the prefix carries it. Two hard boundaries: (1) this vocabulary must NEVER appear in a training caption, where style belongs to the `ferrochrome` trigger and nowhere else; (2) once the LoRA is trained, production prompts drop this prefix and lead with the trigger instead. Say 'cinematic film still', never 'photorealistic' — the latter pulls toward three-point studio product-render lighting, which is the opposite of this style (see art contract).
must_include: a specified lighting environment (LIT-002 — chrome is 100% environment; a void backdrop cannot resolve the material)
visible repair history — weld scars, mismatched panels, field splices

negative_strategy._INERT_ON_FLUX2: Flux.2 IGNORES negative prompts entirely. These entries are retained as CURATION criteria for the ai-eyes gate and human review, NOT as prompt text. Steer adherence with FluxGuidance, never with a negative or with cfg > 1.
must_avoid: neon on the body (NEON-001 — outcasts carry zero body neon)
factory shutlines or even panel gaps (SEAM-001 — those are cyclops grammar)
clean single optic (OPT-001 — permitted only via visible damage)

drift_guards: asymmetry must read as accumulated repair, not as random noise
